# AI ad variations: one winning video ad into 20 distinct creatives

**One winning ad becomes 20 variants: about 7 new concepts and 13 one-change iterations, new hooks swapped in with FFmpeg.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_102d9752a5bb.webp" alt="Three variants of the same cut-resistant glove ad play side by side, each opening on a different hook shot and caption." width="480"></p>

Turns one winning video ad into 20 ad variants that Meta's Andromeda and TikTok treat as different creatives: tag the winner with varg video_analyze, plan two layers (about 7 new concepts that each change message, visual execution or format, plus about 13 single-variable iterations, mostly new hooks), generate the new openers and concepts on varg (Seedance 2.5, Kling 4, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs), swap hooks onto the winner with a tested FFmpeg script (word-boundary cut, normalised parts, 20 ms fade, manifest), re-caption every variant, and export names and a test plan. Use when a seller asks for ad variations, more creatives, hook variants, "scale my winning ad", "make 20 versions of this ad", creative testing volume for Meta or TikTok, or new hooks for an ad that is fatiguing. Not for the testing strategy alone (ad-creative-testing), finding winners from competitors (varg-ad-library-remix), or a brand-new single ad.

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-ad-variants                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-ad-variants --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 83 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | Variant MP4s, manifest and test plan |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$0.05 to tag the winner, ~$0.01 per voiced hook line; clips extra |
| Uses | varg API, varg video_analyze, Seedance 2.5, Kling 4, Nano Banana 2.1, ElevenLabs v4, FFmpeg, Node.js |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

- "Make 20 versions of ./winner.mp4 for Meta, mostly new hooks, and name the files for testing"
- "My best TikTok ad is fatiguing — make 5 new spoken hooks in the same voice and swap them onto the body"
- "Scale this cutting-board ad: plan new concepts with a different persona and format, then the hook variants"
